legend.title: Legend (F7 to close)
legend.outcomes.term: Break · Damage · No change · Success · Great success
legend.outcomes.meaning: The 5 results of a strike, in order: sword lost; −1 grade; unchanged; +1 grade; +2 grades.
legend.ev.meaning: Expected value after 1 strike compared to now. Above ×1 is a gain, below ×1 a loss.
legend.plan.meaning: Expected value if you keep striking and stop at the right time (Frenzy included).
legend.pace.meaning: Swords on hand + new swords each day (a cautious estimate) against the next 3 days of tribute.
legend.fever.meaning: 10 charge (10 normal strikes) starts Frenzy: a few seconds where swords can't break. "~7 strikes each" is how many you usually land in one.
legend.tribute.meaning: Sword value you must offer by the end of the day; tomorrow's is what the game has already set for the next day.
legend.place.meaning: rack slot N = on the rack, slot N; on the floor; on the anvil; tribute table = already offered; in hand = held or in the furnace.
legend.drop.term: safe to drop / best to drop
legend.drop.meaning: Dropping that relic leaves the odds unchanged / costs the least EV when you need a free slot.
legend.star.meaning: A relic for sale that is among the best at cutting Break chance.
legend.safe.meaning: This strike can't Break (0% Break chance).
legend.credits.meaning: Purchases left at the relic shop (paid with +0 swords); shop rerolls.
legend.consumables.meaning: Cracked Dragon Scale blocks a Break on the next strike; Clockwork of Regret undoes the last strike.
